audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Karma while whys[4] and spikes[2] both call it your premier all-in ('drop R behind her and Q-reset her down with no way out'), and 2+ items was given to Irelia while whys[6] says the window evens out.
audit.why: Karma's only escape is Inspire's move speed, which Vanguard's Edge walls off; past two items her Mantra root, shields and Soulflare zone start peeling Irelia off the carries.
audit.corrected: Row 4 to Irelia and row 6 to Skill in both layers as one atomic group with matching ratings — the packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 phase why says 'Karma's ultimate changes the math too' at 6. Mantra is available from level 1 and costs no skill point, so nothing about her ultimate changes at 6 — only Vanguard's Edge does.
audit.why: Riot's R text states it plainly: Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point. Telling the player to reassess because of her level-6 ultimate invents a spike that never happens.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten around Vanguard's Edge cutting the Inspire escape, and states Mantra has been up since level 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3], whys[5], spikes[3] and late all credit Irelia with a passive armour/MR shred — Ionian Fervor is stacking attack speed plus bonus on-hit at max stacks, nothing more. Focused Resolve's flat 12s cooldown appeared nowhere despite being the cooldown every commit hangs on, and Mantra-W's self-heal is never answered with Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s at every rank — a fixed number that makes 'commit when the tether is spent' actionable — and Riot's Mantra bonus on W heals Karma, which is exactly what anti-heal is for.
audit.corrected: Shred replaced with the on-hit ramp in whys[3], whys[5] and spikes[3]; the flat 12s tether written into Key Ability Interactions, spikes[3] and the don't; Executioner's Calling added to itemization for the Mantra-W heal.

edits.before: Vanguard’s Edge walls off his disengage and marks the kill. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Vanguard's Edge walls off the Inspire speed she kites with. Mantra is up from level 1, so 6 changes your math, not hers.

edits.after: Your max-stack Ionian Fervor on-hit comes online; her only self-peel is the Inspire shield on an 8-10s timer, so you win every short trade.

edits.after: Your Trinity/bruiser spike with full reset uptime and four-stack on-hit makes you a lane tyrant — the Inspire shield can't absorb your ramping DPS.

edits.before: Trinity/bruiser spike with full Q-reset uptime and max-stack Bladesurge passive shredding her resists — W eats her poke and you out-DPS the Inspire shield.

edits.before: Track Karma's Focused Resolve: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. When it is down — E-stun, Q-reset through the wave.
edits.after: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s tether that roots you unless you break it by getting out of range — commit the moment it is spent.
